statement.zh: 卡尔胡（尼姆鲁德）伊拉克英国考古学校发掘见 Mallowan《尼姆鲁德及其遗存》（1966，两卷）综合。
statement.en: At Kalhu (Nimrud), British School of Archaeology in Iraq excavations are synthesized in Mallowan Nimrud and Its Remains (1966, 2 vols.).
